summary: RETEST of the HIGH from iteration_32 (unknown trade result + failed verification). Backend only. FIXED and verified end-to-end: user's exact scenario (DISCONNECTED_DURING_TRADE executed + 40x GET /positions 503) → log ERROR 'orden REAL con resultado desconocido … no se pudo verificar en HFM … adoptará por su identificador AIT_xxxxxxxx_o', no 'verificado: no quedó ninguna orden' / 'rechazada', fx_pending_orders doc with _id=link and all fields; after clear_fault the position was adopted in ~2 s with the real strategy, signal_id, SL/TP/qty from the mock, signal executed=true + 'confirmada por su identificador', pending consumed, shadows removed, single ADOPTADA log, no duplicate after several monitor cycles, manual close creates a live trade. Orphan AIT_deadbeef_o adopted as 'adoptada' short 0.02 ('sin registro local'), while a 'manual-1' position on the same symbol is warned once as 'posición externa detectada' and left untouched (not closed by the bot). Unit: open() → kind unknown, attempts=1, link_id AIT_<8hex>_o, 'no se pudo verificar en HFM'; the 45 s RECONCILE_BUDGET_SEC is enforced (positions_hang=25 / read_timeout=20 → raised after 46.5 s with 'sin respuesta en 45 s', order sent exactly once). Pending expiry: a 3h-old pending is deleted with the INFO log, a fresh one kept; reset_account clears pending_orders. Migration present and hfm_alert_after_sec=180. Regression: iter35 (16), iter34 (15), iter18, iter33, iter32, iter21 (10) all pass; my new file 5/5.

minor.issue: db.pending_orders.insert_one runs inside the except handler without protection: a Mongo error (or a duplicate _id, e.g. empty link_id '' if it ever happens twice) would escape as an unhandled exception instead of the 'resultado desconocido' result. Use update_one(upsert=True) or try/except and skip the insert when link is empty.
Adopted orphans get expires_at=None (no time exit) and atr=|entry-sl| fallback; acceptable but worth documenting in the UI/log.
Engine lock is held for up to 45 s during verification (monitor / manual close blocked meanwhile). By design, documented in RECONCILE_BUDGET_SEC comment.
